# Niwa Apartments

> Niwa Apartments is an apartment building at 513 1st Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109, in Seattle's Lower Queen Anne (Uptown) neighborhood — walking distance to Seattle Center. It offers studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments for rent, professionally managed by AGM Real Estate Group, LLC.

## Key facts
- Property name: Niwa Apartments
- Address: 513 1st Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109
- Neighborhood: Lower Queen Anne (Uptown), Seattle
- Layouts: studio, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom
- Building amenities: on-site laundry
- Some homes are income-restricted under Seattle's MFTE/MHA program; income limits apply to those units.
- Managed by: AGM Real Estate Group, LLC
